correctness.rationale: The three symmetry classes exhaust two leaders; invertible 2x2 blocks and the hub Schur complement reproduce exact formulas. A strictly positive Q polynomial excludes same-petal pairs, Descartes plus endpoint signs yields exactly one ratio switch for m=2,3, and P4 plus positive m increment proves hub preference for m>=4. Exact reentrance quadratic has two positive distinct roots. The companion script passed symbolic identities, 300 direct exact inverse comparisons and 268 exhaustive pair comparisons.
